correctness.rationale: The falling-factorial p-adic series F(x)=sum (-1)^j(x)_j converges on Z5 and satisfies D_n=(-1)^n F(n). The finite mod-5 table F(a)=(1,0,1,3,4), F'(a)=(1,3,4,2,4) has all unit derivatives; the difference quotient on each disk is a unit even at arbitrary 5-adic arguments (tail j>=10 divisible by 5). Digit-by-digit Hensel lifting gives a bijection of each disk onto its target disk and hence the exact two-parity frequency. Independent complete recurrence enumeration verified all levels k<=4. The all-k assertion rests on the analytic isometry, not finite tests.

evidence: Known period 2*5^k and interpolation/Hensel machinery; actual new formula c=(2,3,1,1,3).
